notes:
TWO MAIN MEANINGS:

1. CHAPTER/SECTION:
- ⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧1{章|しょう}: Chapter 1
- ⟦{序章|じょしょう}→序章：12534_joshou⟧: prologue
- {終章|しゅうしょう}: final chapter, epilogue
- {章立|しょうだ}て: chapter structure/organization

2. BADGE/MEDAL:
- ⟦{勲章|くんしょう}→勲章：21244_kunshou⟧: medal of honor
- {記章|きしょう}: badge, insignia
- {校章|こうしょう}: school badge/emblem
- {社章|しゃしょう}: company badge

AS A COUNTER:
Used to count chapters: {一章|いっしょう}, {二章|にしょう}, {三章|さんしょう}. Usually preceded by ⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧ in formal writing: {第|だい}{一章|いっしょう}.

CONTRAST (CHAPTER SENSE):
- {章|しょう}: chapter (major division)
- ⟦{節|せつ}→節：19359_setsu⟧: section (subdivision within a chapter)
- {項|こう}: clause/paragraph (smaller unit)
